an4.83:1.1: Catuhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato yathābhattaṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye.
an4.83:1.5: ananuvicca apariyogāhetvā appasādanīye ṭhāne pasādaṃ upadaṃseti, ananuvicca apariyogāhetvā pasādanīye ṭhāne appasādaṃ upadaṃseti.
an4.83:1.6: Imehi kho bhikkhave catuhi dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye. 2.
an4.83:2.1: Catuhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ sagge.
an4.83:2.5: anuvicca pariyogāhetvā appasādanīye ṭhāne appasādaṃ upadaṃseti,
an4.83:2.6: anuvicca pariyogāhetvā pasādanīye ṭhāne pasādaṃ upadaṃseti.
an4.83:2.7: Imehi kho bhikkhave catuhi dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evam sagge
